title: Female Warrior with Hammer
description: A confident young woman with dark hair in a topknot stands in a dynamic pose, holding a large purple warhammer in her left hand while unleashing a vibrant purple and orange energy blast from her right fist. She wears a cropped orange top, dark pants with armor plates, and purple boots against a solid gray background.
